description: This file defines handlers and utilities for managing Microsoft Teams activities, including message handling, member addition, feedback, file consent, and welcome messages within a Teams bot context.

methods.name: serializeAdaptiveCardActionValue
methods.description: Serializes the value of an adaptive card action, returning a string or null.

methods.name: isFeedbackInvokeAuthorized
methods.description: Checks if a feedback invoke activity is authorized based on sender access and configuration.

methods.name: handleFileConsentInvoke
methods.description: Handles file consent invoke activities for large file uploads, managing upload process and user responses.

methods.name: handleFeedbackInvoke
methods.description: Processes feedback invoke activities (like/dislike), logs feedback, and triggers reflection if applicable.

methods.name: registerMSTeamsHandlers
methods.description: Registers handlers for Teams activities, including message, member added, and invoke activities, with special handling for file consent and feedback.
